body:
# Changelog

### Features
- feat(converter): enhance OAuth2 token handling in processAuth function by @sanish-bruno in [#9454](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9454)
- feat(runner): store runner payloads in the file store by @chirag-bruno in [#9408](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9408)
- feat(sqlite-file): add a file store to the SQLite SDK by @chirag-bruno in [#9405](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9405)
- feat(openapi): revamp Create OpenAPI spec Modal by @adwait-bruno in [#9302](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9302)
- feat: show keyboard shortcut hints in menus by @lohit-bruno in [#9426](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9426)
- feat: add unresolved variables info card by @prateek-bruno in [#9401](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9401)
- feat(benchmark): utils to measure over checkpoints, spans, and also drain them by @sid-bruno in [#9292](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9292)
- feat(response-examples): implement "Try" functionality for response examples by @abhishekp-bruno in [#9342](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9342)
- feat: open sidebar openapi specs as workspace tabs by @sachin-bruno in [#9291](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9291)
- feat(sidebar): adds debounce on sidebar search by @sachin-thakur-bruno in [#9045](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9045)
- feat(bruno-sqlite): move cache collection fetch to bruno-sqlite by @shubh-bruno in [#9195](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9195)
- feat(preferences): design update for general settings page by @sachin-thakur-bruno in [#9056](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9056)
- feat: force close db by @sid-bruno in [#9335](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9335)
- feat(wsdl): resolve schemaLocation references to external XSD files by @gopu-bruno in [#9327](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9327)
- feat(tags): add folder-level tags with inheritance by @morsh-bruno in [#9253](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9253)
- feat(theme): add Dracula dark theme by @Ayce45 and @lohit-bruno in [#7815](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/7815)
- feat(theme): add gruvbox dark/light (+variants) by @taylrfnt in [#8153](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/8153)
- feat(ui): Add Cyberdream light and dark themes by @byt3m4st3r in [#8877](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/8877)
- feat(sidebar): virtualize sidebar nested items by @sachin-thakur-bruno in [#9190](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9190)
- feat(scripts): enhanced pre-request scripts handling with environment variable interpolation and added tests by @sharan-bruno in [#9164](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9164)
- feat(CLI): added interpolation for digest auth credentials and corresponding tests by @sharan-bruno in [#9156](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9156)
- feat(headers): show collection and folder headers in the inherited accordian by @pooja-bruno and @sachin-thakur-bruno in [#9129](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9129)
- feat(sidebar): optimize multi-select drag state logic by @Gopi-bruno in [#9202](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9202)
- feat(runner): build run reports from the stored file payloads by @chirag-bruno
- feat(secret-manager): fetch external secrets just in time by @prateek-bruno
- feat(ai): show hint for org disabled providers by @gopu-bruno
- feat(UI): Improve visibility of long variable values in the variables table by @sharan-bruno
- feat(git): fix BranchSelector to support remote branches and improve branch handling by @naman-bruno
- feat(secret-manager): move external secret values from disk to in-memory storage by @prateek-bruno
- feat(license): mask license key in license settings by @Gopi-bruno
- feat(git): add branch selection to workspace clone dialog by @gopu-bruno

### Fixes
- fix(flatpak): fix git not found issue in flatpak package by @Pragadesh-45 and @sid-bruno in [flathub#129](https://github.com/flathub/com.usebruno.Bruno/pull/129)
- fix: adding mock server to test by @utkarsh-bruno in [#9503](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9503)
- fix: adding permission request handler on apps by @utkarsh-bruno in [#9470](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9470)
- fix(export-zip): make ignoredDirectories check case-insensitive by @prateek-bruno in [#9480](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9480)
- fix(preferences): auto save delay error check by @sachin-thakur-bruno in [#9472](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9472)
- fix: retry git metadata dir remove by @prateek-bruno in [#9473](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9473)
- fix: match `form-urlencoded` and `multipart` media types, ignoring params and case by @lohit-bruno in [#9425](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9425)
- fix: ensure we're not importing / exporting .git directory by @prateek-bruno in [#9430](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9430)
- fix(wsdl): include xs:any and xs:group in generated request bodies by @gopu-bruno in [#9429](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9429)
- fix: file cache on makes doesn't respect the ignored folders by @utkarsh-bruno in [#9344](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9344)
- fix(workspaces): allowed duplicate workspace names, enforcing uniqueness on the filesystem path instead by @ravindra-bruno in [#9392](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9392)
- fix(wsdl): fix choice option count when elements are grouped by @gopu-bruno in [#9409](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9409)
- fix(runner): bru runner stopExecution should halt the entire run by @sharan-bruno in [#9285](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9285)
- fix(ui): preferences Request Timeout warning message streamlined by @abhidev-bruno in [#9406](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9406)
- fix(ui): responsive runner toolbar UI by @morsh-bruno in [#9338](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9338)
- fix(runner): unable to keep the scroll in top while checking Collection Runner iteration summary of each run by @sharan-bruno in [#9396](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9396)
- fix: measure total response time instead of TTFB (#7594) by @pkrisko and @lohit-bruno in [#7628](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/7628)
- fix(headers): default disable headers import by @pooja-bruno in [#9329](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9329)
- fix(sidebar): drag and drop request and folders by @sachin-thakur-bruno in [#9364](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9364)
- fix(environment): name column resize in environemnt table by @sachin-thakur-bruno in [#9341](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9341)
- fix(app): run app guests in a secure context (#8838) by @sid-bruno in [#9311](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9311)
- fix: honor ignore paths on initial collection scan (#9204) by @sachin-thakur-bruno in [#9333](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9333)
- fix(autocomplete): stopped invalid ghost text in script editors by @ravindra-bruno in [#9287](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9287)
- fix(certificates): update certificate type mappings from 'pem'/'pkcs12' to 'cert'/'pfx' in conversion functions and tests by @abhishekp-bruno in [#9274](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9274)
- fix(OpenAPI): OpenAPI spec creation not working by @sachin-bruno in [#9191](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9191)
- fix(sidebar): align API spec row styling with collection rows by @adwait-bruno in [#9178](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9178)
- fix: add missing runtime dependencies for pnpm strict mode by @aritradhabal in [#8099](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/8099)
- fix(mock-server): fixed Delay and Duration columns overlapping in the mock server request log by @ravindra-bruno in [#9256](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9256)
- fix(response-pane): enhanced script error message handling by @abhishekp-bruno in [#9254](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9254)
- fix(generate-code): double cookie in generate code when libcurl is selected by @sachin-thakur-bruno in [#9271](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9271)
- fix(migration): improve pm.sendRequest with arrow expression callback translation by @abhishekp-bruno in [#9171](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9171)
- fix(migration): keep the call wrapping a response member in pm.sendRequest callbacks by @abhishekp-bruno in [#9162](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9162)
- fix(opencollection): preserve multipart form content-type on import and export by @sundram-bruno in [#9155](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9155)
- fix(generate-code): generate code cookie header deduplication by @Gopi-bruno in [#9159](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9159)
- fix(sidebar): open the file rename modal from the rename shortcut on JS files by @lohit-bruno
- fix(api-spec): Exporting a collection doesn't open the created spec automatically in the viewer with its tab by @sachin-bruno
- fix(ui): improve column width calculation for dynamic data by @sharan-bruno
- fix: added app distinctID to trial-to-paid flow by @ankit-bruno
- fix(license): increased the width of license key as we are using uuidv4 by @sachin-thakur-bruno
- fix(import-export): include external secrets in OpenCollection environment while exporting by @sharan-bruno
- fix(sidebar): restore bruno.json drag guard and fix multi-select drag… by @Gopi-bruno
- fix(git): keeping a deleted-file conflict no longer empties the request by @ravindra-bruno

### Others
- test(workspaces): asserted the header reads My Workspace after closing the active workspace by @ravindra-bruno in [#9489](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9489)
- fix(docs): add link for the hindi readme translation to all readme pages by @alanansari in [#9149](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9149)
- test(safe-mode): use localhost testbench in Prod env for CI by @pooja-bruno in [#9469](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9469)
- test: Added stubbed test for TC-1011, refactored TC-3213 by @shivang-bruno in [#9109](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9109)
- refactor(sqlite): replace renderer hooks with per-statement IPC by @chirag-bruno in [#9421](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9421)
- chore: update coderabbit instructions for feature parity by @bijin-bruno in [#9390](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9390)
- chore: update the outdated contributing guide by @bijin-bruno in [#9388](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9388)
- chore(claude): co-related features and parity rules by @bijin-bruno in [#9384](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9384)
- test(cli): add test for isSafeMode by @pooja-bruno in [#9340](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9340)
- refactor: generalize error occured text and code by @prateek-bruno in [#9348](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9348)
- chore: add status-new label to issue templates by @aditya-bruno in [#9355](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9355)
- chore(builds): force terser plugin configuration to utilize available CPU cores by @sid-bruno in [#8907](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/8907)
- docs(claude): add the sqlite sdk rule by @chirag-bruno in [#9255](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9255)
- chore(sidebar-tests): added sidebar e2e tests for search, collapse and scroll into vie on active tab by @sachin-thakur-bruno in [#8891](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/8891)
- ui(auth): show inherited auth fields as read-only and link to the source by @pooja-bruno in [#9281](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9281)
- ui(auth): move request auth mode selector below the tabs fits by @pooja-bruno in [#9222](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9222)
- test: added manage workspace tests TC-2611, TC-2612, TC-3275, TC-6086 by @shivang-bruno in [#9068](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9068)
- fix(tests): update folder tags integration tests to strip file extension by @sanish-bruno in [#9304](https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9304)
- fix(bruno-tests): migrate secret manager config by @pooja-bruno
- fix: adding license guard for duplicate workspace tests by @utkarsh-bruno
- fix: tests turn a license-server outage into a green skip by @utkarsh-bruno
- fix: unblock windows unit tests by @prateek-bruno
- test(ai): add e2e for ai provider disabled hint by @gopu-bruno
- chore: update feature parity rules for ee by @bijin-bruno
- chore: lint fixes from sync by @sid-bruno

### New Contributors
* @shivang-bruno made their first contribution in https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9068

* @taylrfnt made their first contribution in https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/8153
* @Ayce45 made their first contribution in https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/7815
* @aditya-bruno made their first contribution in https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9355
* @pkrisko made their first contribution in https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/7628
* @abhidev-bruno made their first contribution in https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/pull/9406

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/usebruno/bruno/compare/v4.2.1...v4.3.0
